strategy.withdrawnBatch: Retain open-to-draft management. SSR and receipt list use owner-filtered minimal stored-title projections. API returns only own receipt snapshots, null editable form and original form version; no current draft configuration or private notes.
strategy.review: Submitted/reviewing/returned retain the four review targets. Accepted/rejected allow only the same result or returned. Returned/rejected require trimmed applicant-visible feedback. UI and API share the transition rule; existing serializable transactions, locks, revision comparison and audits remain.
strategy.questionnaire: Core fields stay directly visible. Every forward jump is rejected if its skipped interval includes any of the seven core fields. Extension-only branches and ending after the core fields remain supported.

targetedHttpE2E.execution: scoped retests after fixture corrections; includes the original complete recruitment flow and new concurrent review case

checks.independentReadOnlyReview: PASS; no blocking source defect found; execution evidence comes from this integration task
